reviews.title: Baboo
reviews.text: Got to be a way to stop tracking

reviews.title: Needs to have option to edit fast
reviews.text: I was using Zero before and it allows you to edit your fasting times. If you forgot to start your fast but know what time you stopped eating you can go back and correct it.

reviews.title: Trash
reviews.text: You have to immediately click on or you window starts whenever. Sooo stupid!!

reviews.title: WIP
reviews.text: One major flaw for this imperfect person. I need a time function force when I forget to click to start or end the fast

reviews.title: A better explanation
reviews.text: I just wish the app with an explanation on how to use it better. I’m literally just guessing

reviews.title: Just OK
reviews.text: If you miss an entry you’re out of luck!  Haven’t figured out how to go back and adjust the times.

reviews.title: Doesn’t allow editing
reviews.text: I like the interface but the one thing I’d like to see added is the option to edit fasting times. I’m forgetful and I don’t go on the app right away when I start fasting and it doesn’t allow for editing. Previous apps I’ve used allowed me to change the start and end time when I fast

reviews.title: Option
reviews.text: Need to be able to stop/start timer

reviews.title: Waste of time
reviews.text: Don’t allow editing of the timings when you fast so not very good if you forget to log it
